Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Syzygy Bio — POC plan & initial credit proposal

Marissa,

Thanks for the plan — appreciate the quick turnaround. A few items from our side:

1) We need a longer window to validate integration across two teams: asking for an 8-week POC instead of 6.
2) The technical team flagged sampling variance — it will require an extra pass at larger scale. Can you increase the pilot credits to $40k?
3) Procurement: any concession > $25k requires executive approval and a short note on expected go/no-go criteria.

If Redwood can commit to the 8-week window plus $40k credits (or an acceptable compromise), we can move to a signed SOW and environment setup. Otherwise we need to evaluate alternate vendors.

Appreciate quick feedback,

Sara Patel
Head of Applied ML | Syzygy Bio

Hi Aditya / Priyom,

Forwarding Syzygy's ask below. Quick context and my recommendation:
- Account: Syzygy Bio (applied ML org evaluating ligand-matching workflow)
- Current proposal: 6 weeks + $15k credits (already offered)
- Customer request: 8 weeks + $40k credits. Procurement notes any concession > $25k needs exec signoff.
- Deal: anticipated Q1 run-rate $60k+/mo if they convert; high strategic value in biotech vertical for references.

My recommendation (for approval consideration):
Option A (aggressive): Approve full request — 8-week POC + $40k non-recoupable credits + 10% committed discount for Q1 (if they convert). Rationale: accelerates win, signals commitment to strategic biotech reference.
Option B (compromise): Approve $30k credits + 7-week extension + 5% discount on first quarter — reduces concession size while keeping signal.

Attachments: Syzygy_POC_plan_v1.pdf, Syzygy_budget_request.xlsx (see credit math tab).

Ask: please review and reply with approval or adjustments. If you want a one-line exec note for procurement, I can draft.

Thanks,

Marissa
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
